stemMd: Some archived maps are fragile. All fragile items require careful handling. What must follow?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every carefully handled item is fragile.

options.textMd: Some archived maps require careful handling.

explanationMd: The fragile archived maps exist and fall under the general handling rule. Consequently at least some archived maps require careful handling. No condition establishes what proportion of all maps is fragile.

distractorRationale.e: The rule is not restricted to maps.
